raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled down in midfield about 4Ls off the pace, switched wide from 700M before giving limited response in the straight. Couldn't sustain run late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位。自七百米處起移出外疊。直路上對催策反應有限。末段未能保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly, ridden along to lead, gave ground and failed to respond over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 搶口，在催策下取得領先。末段墮退，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, forced three wide final bend, pushed along, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎走第三疊。受推策，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide from 600M, challenged the leaders turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。入直路時挑戰領先馬匹。趨近二百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Shifted out shortly after start, 2nd in the early and middle stages, travelled keenly and lost position near 700M, raced slightly better than midfield on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑。早段及中段居第二位，搶口。接近七百米處時失位。直路彎居中間稍前位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W3W3W) Away well, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位。直路彎未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W2W3W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W2W3W) 居前列，走勢良佳。在催策下穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Raced on rail in 5th position early. Weakened at 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段走貼欄第五位。一百五十米力弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride near last 8-9Ls off the pace, had big task in hand top of straight, failed to respond and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置，留力候上，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。直路初落後甚遠。末段對催策毫無反應，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, had to wait for run briefly entering home straight headway between horses, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時一度須等待空位出現，在馬匹之間追前。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced behind midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能增速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat at the back 3 wide, never in contention.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Slow to jump, sat towards rear, no contention.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。未有參與競逐。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced wide throughout from high draw, one paced under pressure from 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後沿途走外疊。自四百米處起在催策下保持同速。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Out with rest, positioned slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 500M, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, made good ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Tracked leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on well but headed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide after passing 450M, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, hit the front 75M, kept on well to the line and scored. (Dead-Heat)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後走第三疊。直路初未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空。七十五米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。（平頭冠軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W3W) Held up last, pushed along and outpaced middle stages, switched widest for clear run 200m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受推策，但未能跟上步速。二百米處移出最外疊以望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Mid-field, struggling from over 400m out and well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起掙扎上前，所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Travelled mainly 3-wide with cover in midfield, slightly inconvenienced over 200M out, fought on steadily closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。二百米處略受妨礙。末段持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled off midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Waited with towards rear, wide final bend, stayed on well and made up several places final 150m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎走外疊。最後一百五十米保持佳勢，追前數位。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Began awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until approaching final 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近最後五十米。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1050M, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。跑過一千零五十米處後追近，入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, taken widest final bend, no extra final 150m and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎被帶出最外疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, under pressure 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。四百米處受催策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, minor progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W4W3W) Raced wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W4W3W) 居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, headway 300m out, stayed on well final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處追前。最後一百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, dropped to last pair into home straight, strong run between horses from 300m out, edged ahead close home, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。自三百米處起在馬匹之間衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out 400M, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Made running, raced keenly, drew away early stages, headed by winner 600m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑，搶口。早段帶離對手。六百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out approaching 700M, 4 wide turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。趨近七百米處時向外移出。入直路時走第四疊。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, in rear, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，被拋離，居後列。自六百米處起難以保持位置。自三百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W) Across from widest draw to press leader, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策。末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped out of stalls, three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞。居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, under pressure from the 500M, weakened soon after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，其後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on outer, hampered near 700M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Caught 3 wide near the rear, nothing extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 to 6 lengths back in the middle stages, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。中段落後五至六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the inside early, moved a bit closer along the rail in the middle stages, 4 lengths back turning in, angled out early in straight, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。早段居後列，走內疊。中段沿欄略為追近。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W3W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍，對頭兩名馬匹未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 550M, a bit closer on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。自五百五十米處起走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W2W2W) Raced wide, improved to press leader 1100m out, unable to hold position 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W2W2W) 走外疊。千一米處推進以追迫領放馬。四百米處未能保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved closer on turn, 4 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路初在催策下反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, similar position on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, never better than midfield, one paced under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，從未超越中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat off midfield 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Travelled keenly in first few, over 2L back in 4th in back straight, came under pressure approaching final turn, found no extra when inconvenienced over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 搶口，居首數位之內。對面直路上居第四位，落後逾兩個馬位。趨近直路彎時受催策。一百五十米處受妨礙，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Wide early, across to track leader, pressed leader top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 早段走外疊，切入以跟隨領放馬。直路初追迫領放馬，最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly and switched for clear run 400m out, challenged and every chance in home straight, no extra final 100m, checked close home.
(Sustained a small abrasion to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，四百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路上展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百米再無餘力，接近終點時勒避。
（右膝輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, 2 wide from 800M, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。自八百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, closed off nicely, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sluggish start, rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 600M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。六百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Away well, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the outside, finished off strongly, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段衝刺強勁，叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, mid division, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及發生碰撞。居中間位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began smartly from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 400M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。四百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, driven 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost four lengths, always well in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後四個馬位。全程遙居於後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 1100M, slightly improved in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。千一米處向外移出，中段略為推進。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 450m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百五十米處向外移出推進。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, made some headway thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路早段難以望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W3W3W) Slowly away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide from 800M, 4 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起走第三疊。直路彎落後四個馬位。入直路時走大外疊，衝刺平穩。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, briefly hampered 100m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。一百米處一度受阻礙。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Held up in last pair, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 留居最後兩位之內。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W) Mid-field, headway from 400m out, still fourth 100m out, stayed on strongly to edge ahead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起上前，一百米處仍居第四位。保持勁勢，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Mid-field, pushed along 400m out, unable to quicken, stayed on late, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處受推策，未能加速。末段保持走勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Held up early, headway into mid-field past halfway, rail run into home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 早段留後。跑過半程後追前至中間位置。入直路時走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十二檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed approaching 300M, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。趨近三百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, raced keenly, unable to pick up from pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，搶口。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/4L back turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Showed good speed to lead, headed by winner halfway out, weakened final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;前速甚快，取得領先。半程時被頭馬超越。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Chased leaders, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Tracked leaders, unable to hold position halfway, flattened out final 200m.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。半程時未能保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Shared led on the stands' rail, weakened final furlong.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;並排領先，走外欄。最後二百米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat on pace 3 from the stands' rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列，走外欄第四疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Disputed led, ridden to chase leader 400m out, ran on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;爭奪領先。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield on the rail, ran on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。以佳勢上前，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, angled out in the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上向外移出。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Chased leader, under pressure 550m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 追趕領放馬。五百五十米處受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until final 50M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至最後五十米。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) A little awkward away and threw the head about, over-raced in the early and middle stages, momentarily held up at the top of home straight, ran on fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘略為笨拙，將頭兩邊擺動。早段及中段搶口。直路初一度受困。末段在催策下走勢不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Under pressure to press leader, struggled to hold position from 500m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 受催策，追迫領放馬。自五百米處起難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final 300M. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側，最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 800M, retook the lead turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策上前，取得領先。接近八百米處時被超越。入直路時重奪領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Failed to show his usual gate speed and had to settle close to rear, shifted in abruptly across heels to obtain clear room 350m out, stayed on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;未能展現一貫前速，居接近後列位置。三百五十米處急促向內移入，橫越對手後蹄以望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, headed in the Straight, kept on nicely for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。直路上被超越。保持佳勢，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Soon in front from draw 1, pressed by rival in the lead throughout, headed inside 300M, weakened over final 200M. (Jockey could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，瞬即取得領先。領放，沿途受對手追迫。三百米處被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Made running, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 50m out, sticking to task, crossed by runner-up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。直路初受催策。五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼，接近終點時被亞軍馬匹過頭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after sluggish start, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，其後居後列。五百五十米處受催策。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Chased leaders, outpaced halfway out and gave ground, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追趕領先馬匹。半程時未能跟上步速及墮退。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, gave ground from the 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。自二百米處起墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。走勢強勁，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Ridden along to share outside lead, traveled reasonably well, weakened passing 200M (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 受催策，並排領先，走外疊。走勢不俗。跑過二百米處時轉弱。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Broke well from wide draw and across to make running, headed by winner 200m out, no extra final 100m and just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，切入以領放。二百米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米再無餘力，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Prominent and wide early stages, just over 3L back rounding home bend, tired noticeably in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段居前列，走外疊。轉直路彎時落後稍逾三個馬位。直路上已疲態畢呈。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W2W) Began only fairly from the widest draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W2W) 自大外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, weakened quickly over 200m out.
(Jockey dropped whip at 150M.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。二百米處迅速轉弱。
（於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
（心律不正常。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division against far rail, briefly tight for room when under pressure 300m out, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，走外欄。三百米處受催策時一度受緊迫。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on without threatening top 3.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Caught 3-wide without cover chasing leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M and weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began awkwardly, trailed the field to straight, widest turning in for home, only ran past well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙。直路前尾隨馬群。轉入直路時走最外疊。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Took up the front-running position early and posted some very fast sectionals, folded up quickly over final stages and had to pay the price.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段取得領先，以甚快步速領放。耗力太多，末段迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide throughout, weakened passing 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。沿途走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) With leaders, ceded position to travel one-out-one-back in 4th onto home bend, kept on in straight until faded inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居領先馬匹之間。開始轉直路彎時墮居第二疊第二位，即馬群中的第四位。直路上保持走勢，直至最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Settled just worse than midfield in 8th mainly about 5L off the pace, gained closer to 3L 7th into straight but did not find much room most of the way, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 大多居中間稍後的第八位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。入直路時追近至第七位，落後三個馬位，但直路上大部分途程空位不足。未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W2W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, weakened over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W2W) 居前列，走勢一般。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway final bend to chase leaders, sustained headway to challenge 300m out, stayed on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前，追趕領先馬匹。三百米處持續追前以展開挑戰。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to challenge 200m out, share of lead and every chance 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處受催策展開挑戰。一百米處並排領先，一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W) Began well from gate 10, ridden along to cross to be in 2nd spot, held his ground in the final stages, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，在催策下切入，居第二位。末段保持位置，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Taken back, raced 2 wide at rear early. Made progress on the outside in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 留後，早段於馬群後列二疊位置競跑。直路上沿跑道外側上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, made contact near 1000M and 850M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。接近一千米處及八百五十米處時兩度被對手觸碰。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, checked near the 150M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。接近一百五十米處時勒避。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Raced wide from high draw, improved to track pace before halfway, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，走外疊。半程前推進上前以跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W4W) Rear of mid-field, taken wide and forward move turning into home straight, sustained run to lead 150m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時移出外疊及上前。持續上前，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, settled in front of midfield, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，入直路時走勢暢順。走勢良佳，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact with the gate on jumping, sat rear, made some ground from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂，居後列。末段自後列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 600m out, ridden top of home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路初受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken across from wide draw, raced towards rear, stayed on at the one pace under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後切入內疊，居後列。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Keen towards rear, forward move out wide into mid-field at halfway, headway 300m out, shifted left briefly 200m out, stayed on well, every chance final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，搶口。半程時上前至中間位置，走外疊。三百米處追前。二百米處一度向外斜跑。末段保持佳勢，最後五十米已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 500M, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時走第二疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, dropped out from wide draw, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，墮後。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Shifted out at the start and was slowest into stride, recovered to race in midfield, closed off final 300M evenly but never able to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，展步最慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。最後三百米以穩勢衝刺，但從未能挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped ok from gate 6 but unable to find cover in midfield, held his ground in the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第六檔出閘尚可，居中間位置，但未能取得遮擋。末段保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W2W) Sent forward from high draw and raced wide, tracked leader, improved into share of lead turning into home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。轉入直路時上前，並排領先。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W1W) Mid division, ridden top of home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W1W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰，以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W2W) Raced wide, tracked pace, forward move halfway to race outside of leader, unable to stay with that rival, one paced under pressure home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 走外疊，跟隨領放馬。半程時上前居領放馬外側競跑，其後未能跟上該駒。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, pressed on rounding the Turn, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢良佳。轉直路彎時受催策。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden to hold position 600m out, shifted out final bend, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處在催策下保持位置。直路彎向外斜跑。其後未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat last, crowded rounding the Home Turn, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受擠迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2WNIL) Retired from the event. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2WNIL) 被收停。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W) With leaders briefly before settling in midfield about 3L off the pace, gained closer on rail to 2L 4th over 600M out but crowded 400M out, unable to make any further impression under pressure after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W) 早段一度與領先馬匹並跑，其後居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。六百米處沿欄追近，居第四位，落後兩個馬位。四百米處受擠迫。入直路後受催策，但未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move 450M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處開始上前。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 13, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘後留後，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Well there, became 3rd some 1.5L back rounding home bend, renewed effort over 600M out sharing lead into straight, folded up quickly inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居好位。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後約一個半馬位。六百米處重新發力。入直路時並排領先。最後一百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, headed by rivals top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初被對手超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled 3 wide near midfield, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, pressured for lead and one of three that raced clear to halfway, headed over 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在催策下保持領先位置，為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處被超越，轉弱。最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 200M, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後二百米未能抗衡頭馬，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently, took the lead near 1250M, led by a length in the middle stages, kept on well in straight, shifted out abruptly 100M, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列。接近一千二百五十米處時取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢。一百米處急促向外斜跑。保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 1-3/4L back turning in, hit the front 200M, peaked and headed 150M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。二百米處取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W3W) Tracked pace, improved to challenge 300m out, led 200m out, ran on strongly to go clear final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處上前展開挑戰，二百米處取得領先。最後一百米走勢強勁，帶離對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, headed 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，切入領放。三百米處被超越。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in midfield, made steady headway under pressure after straightening, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路後在催策下穩步上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards rear, angled out at the Turn, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。以穩勢上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Sat last, held up rounding the Home Turn, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受困。超越部分已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Jumped well from gate 13, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, pushed along into home straight, switched inside over 200m out, tight for room final 100m, unable to be ridden out fully.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策。二百米處移入內疊。最後一百米受緊迫，未能被全力催策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W5W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持佳勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, saved ground, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 950m out, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。九百五十米處移出外疊開始發力。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Settled behind midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, dropped to last place 750m out and soon ridden, passed a few tiring rivals in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。七百五十米處墮居包尾位置，瞬即受催策。直路上超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled well behind from the widest barrier, came under pressure to challenge just inside the 400m saving ground on rail turning in for home, ran on under pressure despite interrupted runs in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居於後。跑過四百米處後在催策下展開挑戰。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。直路上儘管受阻礙，但在催策下上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, effort 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢及被碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處發力。其後在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 3 wide with no cover, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 750M, raced 3 wide, a length or so back on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。七百五十米處開始上前，走第三疊。直路彎落後約一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W4W) In touch with leaders, wide into home straight, strong run to challenge leader 100m out, got on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處向領放馬展開挑戰。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, showed dash top of the Straight, one pace final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初加速上前。最後一百五十米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Towards rear, niggled along a fair way out, gradual headway from 400m out, stayed on into second final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居後列，落後頗遠，受催策。自四百米處起逐漸上前。最後五十米保持走勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Began only fairly from gate 12, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Away ok and sat slightly worse than midfield 3 wide with cover, stayed at the same pace to the line when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘尚可，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider on bend, effort 350m out, not beaten far.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處發力。所負不遠。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, no clear run approaching 150M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段追前甚多。趨近一百五十米處時未能望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, keen middle stages, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。中段搶口。自四百米處起受催策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear 6Ls off the pace, finished off very well final 400M to go 5th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，落後領放馬六個馬位。最後四百米衝刺甚佳，接近終點時取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway wide back straight, chased leaders into home straight, no extra final 75m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。對面直路上上前，走外疊。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後七十五米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Sat towards rear, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居後列，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W4W) In rear, pushed along and wide turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列。轉入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W3W3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, had trouble finding clear running early in the Straight, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Wide in mid-division, lost place turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) From wide draw taken across behind runners, settled near last about 5Ls back, lacked a finishing response in the straight. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，在馬群之後切入，居接近包尾位置，落後約五個馬位。直路上受催策，但衝刺乏力。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled greenly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 居中間之後位置。走勢稚嫩。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Held up in last few, went wide for a run into straight but baulked until 250M out, kept on well in closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 留居最後數位之內。入直路時移出外疊取位，但受困直至二百五十米處。末段保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後五個馬位。其後保持同速，最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden 500m out, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run until final 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled worse than midfield 3 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Slow to begin, ended up racing in last over 10Ls off the pace, in similar position making the home turn before running past a few beaten horses in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。直路上超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slowly away, held up, no impression when ridden along home straight.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，留後。直路上在催策下毫無表現。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W1W1W) Taken back to race at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位，轉入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W5W) Rear of mid-division, headway wide over 400m out, sustained run to lead over 100m out, headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。四百米處在外疊上前。持續上前，一百米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W4W4W) Held up, still in rear entering home straight, stayed on in wide position but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W4W4W) 留後。入直路時仍居後列。末段走外疊，保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, faded final 150m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。最後一百五十米力竭，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, showed good speed to lead, ridden along 250m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，展現甚佳前速以領放。二百五十米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W4W) Wide throughout, mid-field, pushed along and lost place over 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W4W) 沿途居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處受推策，失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, closed off well, had every chance (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳，已獲機會盡展所長。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, bumped near 600M, angled out 400M, showed limited response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時發生碰撞。四百米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Raced 4 wide behind midfield early. Not much progress in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 早段於馬群中間之後四疊位置競跑。直路上進展不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on but no further impression late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W4W) Away well enough, restrained to race in midfield, had 5Ls to make up on leader 400M, ran on steadily to the line for 4th without troubling the easy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W4W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬五個馬位。末段穩步上前，取得第四名，未能威脅輕鬆勝出的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, lacked pace to challenge.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百米處。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd on rail, gained closer on the inside turning in for home, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時追近，走內疊。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, under pressure to hold position on bend, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎在催策下保持位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Caught racing wide without cover in midfield 4-5Ls away, stayed on well final 300M to claim 2nd just before line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間位置，落後四至五個馬位，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米保持佳勢，僅於過終點前取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, briefly hampered 500m out, short of room 100m out, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處一度受阻礙。一百米處空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Trailed the field throughout after slow start, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後沿途尾隨馬群。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W4W) Jumped only fairly , settled at the back of the field, brought wide into straight but gave no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。入直路時移出外疊，但對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat behind midfield near center track, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat near the rear on the rail, lay in and never seriously tested, did made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居後列，走外欄。內閃，從未能真正施為。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon took up running with rails run holding narrow advantage to 300M, fought on under pressure until swamped for a placing final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭競跑，走內欄。以短距離領先直至三百米處。在催策下持續力拼，末段被後上馬匹過頭，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Began from the middle draw to make all, taking advantage of the slow early tempo to obtain rails run over 800M out, driven over 2L clear briefly inside the 150M, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 自中檔出閘，一放到底。利用賽事早段慢步速的優勢，八百米處佔取內欄位置。受催策，一百五十米處一度帶離逾兩個馬位。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Chased leader, every chance 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。三百米處一度甚具爭勝機會。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Fast into stride, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘迅速，居前列，走外欄。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 2 wide, carried wider 450M, finished off very strongly, won by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居第三位，走第二疊。四百五十米處被帶出較外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，以短距離之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat toward rear, switched out rounding the Turn, showed some dash over the final 100M, just missed.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。最後一百米略為加速上前，僅敗。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, hard ridden from 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。自三百米處起受力策。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, picked up prominent position under pressure onto first turn, obtained one back rail position in 3rd about 750M out, hung on well for 2nd in straight without ever threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞。開始轉首個彎位時受催策，佔取前列位置。約七百五十米處佔取第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw travelling keenly on heels in early stages, 3-wide in rear rounding home bend swinging widest into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後留後。早段搶口，緊貼他駒後蹄。轉直路彎時居後列，走第三疊。入直路時移出最外疊，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) A bit keen in mid-field, stayed on well final 200m, still gaining on front two at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置，略為搶口。最後二百米保持佳勢。過終點時仍繼續追近首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 200M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently on the inside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Raced in rear, struggled to hold position final bend, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居後列。直路彎難以保持位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Settled towards the rear two off the outside rail, unable to quicken when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;居後列，走外欄第三疊。在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6-1/2L back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, made good progress thereafter to make frame. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空。其後追前甚多，取得第四名。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Showed good speed to lead, headed 600m out, remained prominent, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;展現甚快前速領放。六百米處被超越，仍居前列。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled strongly until 250M, slightly weakened.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢強勁直至二百五十米處。略為轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well and showed good speed to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，展現甚快前速領放。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 9, raced prominently on the inside early, allowed rival to cross near 750M, sat right behind the leader on turn, kept on well in straight but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，早段居前列，走內疊。接近七百五十米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎緊隨領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，但一直以些微距離落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run after turning in, bumped 300M and 200M, found daylight approaching 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後未能望空。三百米處及二百米處發生碰撞。趨近一百米處時望空。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W6W) Made contact at start, raced slightly behind midfield on outer, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W6W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled just behind the lead, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield early, 2 wide after passing 750M, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。早段居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。跑過七百五十米處後走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader, kept on well to the line to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, positioned 4 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same position on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 200M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘略為緩慢，落後領放馬四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初未能望空，二百米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced prominently on the stands' side, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) From draw 14 showed good pace early stages, went forward setting fast tempo, headed by pursuing rivals near 200M, faded late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 自第十四檔出閘，早段展現甚快前速，上前以甚快步速領放。接近二百米處時被緊追的對手超越，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began awkwardly and bumped, raced behind midfield on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘笨拙及發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W3W) Raced wide from high draw, started well but soon eased back, lost place and last 400m out, left behind from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即收慢留後，走外疊。四百米處失位，居包尾位置，其後被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, switched out at the Turn, failed to respond in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎向外移出。直路上對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Rear of mid-field, no response to pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處對催策毫無反應，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Sat near the rear, never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 居接近包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield on rail, in similar position turning into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。轉入直路時居相若位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader, unable to keep tabs on that rival from 300m out, stuck to task to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起未能跟上領放馬。持續力拼，保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, inconvenienced near 900M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時受妨礙。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路初空位不足，一百五十米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, moved closer on turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點。末段僅能力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead final 50m, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 8 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後約八個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider on bend, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出更外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in rear top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W3W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail just off the speed, threw his head about in the middle stages, lacked a finish effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。中段搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Settled midfield, held up at the Turn, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受困。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 350M, kept on well in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Towards rear, headway 400m out, stayed on home straight despite tending to hang right, fared best of those coming from off pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 居後列。四百米處追前。儘管在直路上傾向內閃，但保持走勢。在後上馬匹中表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處順勢上前挑戰。未能推進。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: THE HONG KONG COUNTRY CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄
raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 香港鄉村俱樂部挑戰盃（讓賽）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced towards rear, late headway but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W1W2W4W) Rail position in mid-field, good headway final bend, stayed on well in home straight but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W1W2W4W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追前甚多。直路上保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W2W2W3W) Sat handy, made good ground over the concluding stages, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W2W2W3W) 居前列。末段追前甚多，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, ridden along 500m out, some headway early in home straight, unable to sustain and weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處受催策。直路初略為追前。最後一百米無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) Settled in midfield in 6th mainly some 4L back, commenced move on top of home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure to hit the front briefly 150M out only to be caught close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 主要居中間第六位，落後約四個馬位。直路彎早段開始上前。入直路時移出最外疊。在催策下上前，一百五十米處一度取得領先，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, finished off well to make frame without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能威脅首三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W4W5W) Held up, taken wide final bend, one paced and never dangerous.
(Sustained a minor abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a minor abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 留後。直路彎被帶出外疊。保持同速，從未能構成威脅。
（右前腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Took up running on rail over 1300M out, increased tempo early in back straight kicking over 2.5L clear, came back to the field rounding home bend, folded up quickly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 千三米處取得領先，走內欄。對面直路初加速帶離逾兩個半馬位。轉直路彎時被馬群追上。直路上迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to improve position, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能追前。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward to hold a position ahead of midfield, ran home one paced, soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前，居中間之前位置。末段保持同速，瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly and unbalanced, raced 2 wide towards rear, a bit closer on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，失去平衡，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）
