runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W2W) Tracked pace, tight for room amongst horses early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初在馬匹之間受緊迫，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened inside 150M, failed to respond (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放。最後一百五十米轉弱，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, keen middle stages, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight of room 150m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時須等待空位出現。一百五十米處空位不足。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, lost ground when wideset into straight, ran about and a difficult ride early in straight, baulked for a run inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走最外疊之際失地。直路初斜跑，難以催策。最後一百米受阻。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, chased leaders 2-wide, kept going well turning home, no match for winner's acceleration, went 2nd briefly near 150M but couldn't hold off runner up late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，追趕領先馬匹，走第二疊。轉直路彎時保持佳勢，但加速力不及頭馬。接近一百五十米處時一度進佔第二位，但末段未能抗衡亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Under pressure to hold a position behind midfield, didn't respond turning for home. (Jockey - failed to travel throughout and was not comfortable on the Yielding track. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 受催策以保持中間之後位置。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠順，不適應「黏地」的場地狀況。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled mainly with 2L of pace in 5th or 4th, ran on under pressure to hit the front narrowly 150M out only to be caught final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 大多居第四或第五位，落後領放馬兩個馬位。受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先。僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, obtained clear running until near the 250M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。接近二百五十米處時望空。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along 500m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百米處受推策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居後列。略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Held up last and detached early stages, caught up to main body of runners after 800m, headway into mid-field in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置，早段被拋離。過了八百米處後追上主馬群。直路上追前至中間位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, forward move wide 400m out, stayed on but tended to hang right, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前，走外疊。末段保持走勢，但傾向內閃。未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W3W) Chased leaders in a steadily run race, close enough top of the straight, kept battling to the line and got up for 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，賽事步速平穩。直路初保持落後領先馬匹不遠。末段持續力拼，接近終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 2 wide at rear, wider on turn, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear, wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走外疊。末段速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly on the rail, pressed on near the 600M, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄，走勢暢順。接近六百米處時受催策。末段衝剌強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure 500m out, followed winner through in home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處受催策。直路上跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米以佳勢衝刺，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, switched for clear run 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。二百米處轉換跑線以望空，末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Sat near the rear 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Away on fairly and settled worse than midfield, closed off ok to finish a distant 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段衝刺不俗，取得第五名，但所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, held up last, short of room 300m out to 200m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。三百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, under pressure to challenge over 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處在催策下展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-division, headway halfway as leading trio came back to field, improved to lead 150m out, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。半程時上前，追及被馬群追上的領先三駒。推進，一百五十米處取得領先。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, hung in and never seriously tested. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。內閃。從未能真正施為。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Dropped in from wide draw, raced in last pair, pushed along final bend, stayed on late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入，居最後兩位。直路彎受推策。末段保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Sat worse than midfield, improved passing the 700M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。跑過七百米處時上前。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Taken well back from the widest draw and waited with, commenced move very wide into straight, ran on well down the centre of the track despite hanging, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，遙居於後，留力候上。入直路時開始上前，走大外疊。儘管斜閃，但在跑道中央以佳勢上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持強勁走勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after impeded leaving stalls, dropped to last place 500m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。五百米處墮居包尾位置。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sent forward to be prominent 3 wide, kept on only fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。末段僅能保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, slightly taken back after passing 1200M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。跑過千二米處後稍為留後，走第二疊。中段落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and then checked briefly, in rear, very wide and pushed along turning into home straight, no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，其後一度勒避，居後列，走大外疊。轉入直路時受推策，毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide, under pressure from the 550M, gave ground soon after.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。自五百五十米處起受催策，其後瞬即墮退。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, travelled keenly, run peaked final 150M.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。搶口。最後一百五十米未能再加速。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled off pace 2 wide, closed off okay. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
(Roarer.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列。入直路時須等待空位出現。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。
（患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Crowded leaving stalls, held up in rear, stayed on final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘時受擠迫，留居後列。最後二百米保持走勢，超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, steadied near 850M, 4 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近八百五十米處時收慢。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時未能望空，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W3W2W2W1W) Ridden hard to sit handy, raced wide in the early stages until near the 1000M, gave ground notably from the Back Straight (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W3W2W2W1W) 在力策下居前列。早段走外疊直至接近一千米處。自對面直路起顯著墮退。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, struggling to hold position final bend, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W5W) Forced wider on the track early stages and shuffled back to last 8Ls or so off the leader, made up several places out wide 800m out, soon tired out early in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W5W) 早段被迫走較外疊，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬約八個馬位。八百米處追前數位，走外疊。直路初瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Crowded at start, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W4W) Waited with towards rear in rail position, switched wide on bend for clear run, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W4W) 居後列，留力候上，走內欄。直路彎移出外疊以望空。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W4W) Pressed forward from the widest draw, 4-wide in midfield onto first bend, further headway to be just over 3L back in 5th 3-wide without cover in back straight, dropped away quickly from approaching home straight 500M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。開始轉首個彎位時居中間位置，走第四疊。對面直路上進一步追前，居第五位，落後稍逾三個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。自五百米處趨近直路起迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, always at the back, not much found.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 沿途居後列。末段無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back form gate 13, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W3W) Wide early, tracked pace, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，跟隨領放馬。自二百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, pushed along over 400m out, soon lost position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策，其後瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Wide throughout, raced close up and keen, upsides leaders turning into home straight, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 沿途走外疊，緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。轉入直路時上前追迫領先馬匹。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W4W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made some headway from the 500M, gave ground final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起略為追前。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, not much impression made, raced flat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居後列。無甚表現，走勢平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled worse than midfield, raced keenly, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。搶口。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) From wide draw taken back to last, had 7-8Ls to make up on leader 400M, couldn't improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。四百米處落後領放馬七至八個馬位。未能推進。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Slow to being, sat worse than midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off well, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) In rear after slow start, steadied off heels on occasions, good headway up rail home straight, improving to chase leaders when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，數度收慢避開他駒後蹄。直路上沿欄追前甚多。末段推進上前，追趕領先馬匹，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Prominent, keen early, pushed along 400m out to chase leaders, looked like winner 300m out but weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，早段搶口。四百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。三百米處甚具勝望，但最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W2W) Prominent early stages, drifted some 3L off the pace about 900M out, in similar position in 5th rounding home bend swinging wide into straight, kept on at the one pace without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段居前列。約九百米處墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若的第五位。入直路時移出外疊。保持同速，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length at 400M, peaked and headed 250M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，受催策上前領放。四百米處領先一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Travelled very wide without cover in rear of midfield, yielded ground rounding home bend, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時墮退。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Prominent, took up running over 800M out setting a sound pace, held narrow lead until headed about 250M out, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，八百米處帶頭，以快步速領放。以短距離領先，直至二百五十米處被超越。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, towards the rear 6Ls back, failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，落後六個馬位。直路上未能上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start along the rail to share early pace, crossed by race leaders and lost position 600M out, some 3L back in 4th rounding home bend, faded steadily in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，早段跟上步速，走內欄。六百米處被領先馬匹橫越，失位。轉直路彎時居第四位，落後約三個馬位。直路上逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, no clear run in the Straight, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Never better than midfield, kept on same pace under pressure without quickening in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 從未超越中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier before gradually taken back to race in last few, fought on steadily from a similar position into straight but never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，其後逐漸留居最後數位之內。入直路時居相若位置，持續力拼，但從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Chased leading group in the 6th spot, couldn't keep up after straightening, tired final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第六位。入直路後未能跟上。最後二百米呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well settling within 3L of the pace in 7th, tightened just inside the 600M and baulked briefly upon straightening, ran on steadily under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第七位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。跑過六百米處後受緊迫。入直路時一度受困。在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat near midfield 2 off the outside rail, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居接近中間位置，走外欄第三疊。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped awkwardly, sat worse than midfield on the stands rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Challenged for the lead 3 wide, kept on nicely to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先，走第三疊。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Out in line, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持佳勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2-3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先二又四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, ridden top of home straight, 1l clear 200m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，切入帶頭。直路初受催策。二百米處帶離一個馬位。一百米處被超越。其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Disputed lead between horses, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在馬匹之間爭奪領先。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, took the lead 950M, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。九百五十米處取得領先，入直路時領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, kept on to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。保持走勢，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Average to begin, raced better than midfield, nearer to the middle track, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通。居中間之前位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Bumped start, took the early lead, headed and made contact near 900M, 2nd on turn, hard ridden after passing 350M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，早段領放。接近九百米處時被超越及與對手互相觸碰。直路彎居第二位，跑過三百五十米處後受力策，但反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W9W) Prominent, badly hampered when taken wider by winner 550m out and lost ground, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W9W) 居前列。五百五十米處被頭馬帶出較外疊之際嚴重受阻礙，失地。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 4 wide near midfield, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第四疊。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Led, weakened from the 150M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 領放。自一百五十米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;帶頭。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along from stalls to lead 700m out, kicked 300m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘後受催策。七百米處取得領先。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide, 1-1/2L back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，落後一個半馬位，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced towards rear on the stands' side, hard ridden from 300M but showed no response, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，靠近外欄競跑。自三百米處起受力策，但毫無反應。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began fairly, raced prominently on the stands' rail, challenged the leader after passing 400M, peaked on run approaching 150M, ran on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘一般，居前列，走外欄。跑過四百米處後挑戰領放馬。趨近一百五十米處時未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat at the rear, weakened and gave ground quickly in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列。直路上迅速轉弱及墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，接近終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 800M, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走第二疊。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。最後一百米收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, lost position after passing 750M, positioned 4 wide, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。跑過七百五十米處後失位。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位，走第四疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Mid-division, drifted left under pressure from 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起在催策下向外斜跑。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders, shifted lane 200M to obtain clear running, kept on nicely under top weight to take 4th .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處轉換跑線以望空。在負頂磅下保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Settled in front midfield 2 wide, switched out in the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, stuck to task under pressure and never far away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。在催策下保持走勢。從未遠離領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race behind midfield on outer, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled on pace 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced in midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, weakened from 500M, eased final furlong, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起轉弱，最後二百米收慢。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped heavily out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生大力碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久被碰撞，失去平衡。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, took the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Started fast but unable to hold position, checked and back into mid-field halfway, one paced under pressure, checked briefly 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但未能保持位置。半程時勒避，墮居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。二百米處一度勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, closed off nicely until checked at the 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。衝刺良佳，五十米處勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, sat handy, switched out rounding the Turn, made some ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Began awkwardly from gate 12, raced 3 wide with no cover in midfield, found a 2 wide spot approaching 700M, 3-1/2L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。趨近七百米處時走第二疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced 3 wide no cover, kept on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走第三疊，沒有遮擋。僅能保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, checked briefly halfway and unable to hold position, left behind in rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時一度勒避，未能保持位置。最後二百米被拋離，居後列過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderate start, recovered swiftly between runners to take up running over 950M out setting a smart pace on home bend, led until tiring 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後在馬匹之間迅速恢復走勢，九百五十米處取得領先。直路彎以快步速領放。保持領先直至三百米處呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped on terms and settled 3rd towards the middle part of the track, responded only fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居第三位，在跑道中央競跑。對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L at 400M, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，受催策上前領先。四百米處領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Tracked leaders, bumped 1000m out, ridden along 650m out to chase leaders, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處發生碰撞。六百五十米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded 600m out, ridden along 250m out, ran on well but no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫。二百五十米處受催策。走勢強勁，但未能抗衡頭馬，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W2W) Began well enough, eased back to sit in mid-division 6Ls back, picked up strongly passing 300M, ran on determinedly and got past leader close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W2W) 出閘頗佳，收慢留居中間位置，落後六個馬位。跑過三百米處時加速強勁。末段以勁勢上前，接近終點時超越領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover behind midfield, brought wide for home then closed off strongly to be beaten a head by the long time leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時移至外疊，其後以勁勢衝刺，以一馬頭位之差不敵領先了一段長途程的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven 400m out to chase leaders, not best of runs early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路早段未能完全望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W4W) Stumbled shortly after the start, failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position, ended up in midfield 4-5Ls away, closed off one paced in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W4W) 起步後不久失蹄，未能展現足夠前速以佔取更為靠前位置，居中間位置，落後四至五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, ran on nicely, just got passed near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。以佳勢上前，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Guided to race along the fence in midfield, in a similar spot turning home, finished off moderately under a big weight but couldn't be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。在負重磅下衝刺普通，但末段在緊迫競跑之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Midfield throughout, kept on steadily without quickening in straight, inconvenienced about 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 沿途居中間位置。直路上保持穩勢，未能加速。約一百米處受妨礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, tight of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百五十米處。最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，贏出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Awkward start, raced in touch with leaders, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。保持佳勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 550M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, effort 500m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡。居中間之後位置。五百米處發力上前。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Chased leader, challenged and improved to lead top of home straight, soon headed by winner 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰及上前取得領先。二百五十米處瞬即被頭馬超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven on bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) In last few to straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 直路前居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 3 wide with cover, 2 to 3 lengths back, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後兩至三個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Showed good speed to lead, headed 1000m out, chased leader into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 展現甚快前速領放。一千米處被超越。入直路時追趕領放馬。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled ahead of midfield, 4Ls behind leader 400M, closed off well under pressure for equal 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，四百米處落後領放馬四個馬位。在催策下衝刺良佳，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, short of room 300m out to 200m out, eye-catching headway from rear final 100m, hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。三百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。最後一百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。接近終點時受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, some headway up rail in home straight but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。直路上沿欄略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, not enough room until approaching final 100M, kept on well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。空位不足直至趨近一百米處。保持佳勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped swiftly from middle of the line but happy to let the speed go, settled slightly worse than mid-pack, closed off well despite laying in concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自中檔出閘迅速，讓領先馬匹上前，居中間稍後位置。儘管末段內閃，但衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。未能望空直至二百米處。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Hampered 1300M out, settled behind midfield on rail, came under pressure home bend, steadied between runners 250M out, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 千三米處受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。二百五十米處在馬匹之間收慢。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, lost balance 1000m out, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。一千米處失去平衡。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Sat ahead of midfield just over 2Ls off leader, brought wide from 400M, loomed up and fought hard, briefly in front 150M but run ended passing 100M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。自四百米處起移出外疊。其後在力拼下上前。一百五十米處一度取得領先，但跑過一百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, tracked leaders, travelled strongly final bend to lead top of home straight, stayed on, headed by front three close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎走勢強勁，直路初取得領先。保持走勢，接近終點時被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden to take up running 950M out and rails run 800M out, kicked some 2L clear in front rounding home bend, just held off strong challenges in straight to prevail narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策，九百五十米處取得領先，八百米處移入內欄。轉直路彎時加速帶離約兩個馬位。直路上力拒對手的強勁挑戰，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Caught racing wide in midfield, hung in throughout and responded only fairly in the straight. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途內閃，直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Held a position behind midfield, swung wide into straight for his challenge but made limited progress only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰，但僅能略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in mid-division, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M-100M, kept on without threat to first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處至一百米處之間難以望空。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (4W2W3W) Sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(4W2W3W) 居後列。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent early, dropped to 3L back in 5th 600M out, produced late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列。六百米處墮居第五位，落後三個馬位。最後一百米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W2W) Across to settle in mid-field, switched to secure clear run 200m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W2W) 切入居中間位置，二百米處轉換跑線以望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, got across to track leaders, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on well but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，切入內疊以跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Soon took up running obtaining rails run early in back straight, led the field until joined over 250m out, fought on well under pressure but found fast-finishing winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭。對面直路早段移入內欄。保持領先，二百五十米處被追上。在催策下以佳勢力拼，但未能抗衡衝刺凌厲的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden on bend to chase leaders, travelled smoothly for clear run top of home straight, narrow lead 150m out, no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。走勢暢順，直路初望空。一百五十米處以短距離領先。末段不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead 850M, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。八百五十米處取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢。末段力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden along early to lead, travelled smoothly, kept on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 早段在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride behind mid-division, brought wide to challenge passing 400M before staying on steadily for modest 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 早段未受催策，居中間之後位置，留力候上。跑過四百米處時移出外疊以展開挑戰。其後保持穩勢，取得第五名，表現一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked on run near 100M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初追前頗多。接近一百米處時未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W6W) Wide in mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W6W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初難以保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Mid-field, smooth headway into contention 300m out, quickened to lead 200m out and soon in control, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處以暢順走勢上前，躋身爭勝行列。二百米處加速以取得領先，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began quickly but held up on rail behind leader, became 3rd in a similar position early in back straight, kept on one pace without quickening in home straight and faded inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，留居領放馬之後，走內欄。對面直路早段居相若第三位。直路上保持同速，未能加速。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Reserved in mid-division, stayed on steadily under top weight over final 300M, not going the pace to challenge leaders late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 留居中間位置。最後三百米在負頂磅下保持穩勢。末段未能加速上前挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, held up for clear running 300M to 100M before fading away final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 保持落後領先馬匹不遠。三百米處至一百米處之間受困而未能望空。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Awkward start, raced very wide without cover throughout, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Blundered badly on jumping with jockey becoming unbalanced and the horse losing ground, settled near rear throughout and couldn't go on turning into the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 躍出時嚴重失蹄，導致騎師失去平衡，失地。沿途居後列。轉入直路時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W3W) Bumped and became unbalanced at the start, settled towards the rear 6Ls away, wide into the straight but couldn't finish off when asked. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，落後六個馬位。入直路時走外疊，但在催策下衝刺乏力。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Bumped heavily shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, angled out 400M, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 起步後不久被大力碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。四百米處向外移出。衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Travelled 3-wide in midfield, commenced move entering home straight, unable to quicken under pressure and made no further impression inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時開始上前。最後二百米在催策下未能增速，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stumbled leaving stalls, raced in touch with leaders, effort 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時失蹄，早段緊隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, held up top of the Straight, closed off nicely once in the clear, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段望空後以佳勢衝刺，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began well from a tricky draw, raced better than midfield but trapped 3 wide, no cover on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Jumped on terms, settled down behind midfield, 3-4Ls off leader coming into straight but responded only fairly and failed to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後領放馬三至四個馬位，但對催策反應僅屬一般，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced very wide, weakened passing 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走大外疊。跑過二百米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 2 to be chasing leader along the fence, weakened quickly passing 300M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，追趕領放馬，走內欄。跑過三百米處時迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) From widest draw unable to cross runners on its inside and raced very wide without cover in midfield for the majority of the race, fought on steadily final 300M to finish a non-threatening 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自最外檔出閘，未能超越內側馬匹，大部分途程居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米持續力拼，取得第五名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處發力。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Dropped back to a rearward spot after the jump, driven along 500M, closed off steadily down the outside but had too much to make on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 出閘後墮居後列。五百米處受催策。末段在外疊以穩勢衝刺，但落後領先馬匹太遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Travelled mainly 3-wide in midfield, slightly worse and wider rounding home bend, fought on steadily under pressure inside final 300M until hampered 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時略為墮後，走更外疊。最後三百米在催策下持續力拼，五十米處受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Unable to slot in from wide draw, caught wide in midfield and left without cover from 600M, ran home well enough final 300M to be beaten 1.5L at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，未能切入內疊，居中間位置，走外疊。自六百米處起沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺良佳，過終點時以一個半馬位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Chased leaders in 3rd, fought hard to stay in contention on straightening, couldn't keep up with leaders final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。入直路時力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米未能跟上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Caught wide no cover early stages, strode forward to settle outside the lead, in 3rd spot making home turn but didn't have much left in tank on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，沒有遮擋。展步上前居領放馬外側。轉直路彎時居第三位，入直路時無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Raced wide towards rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) From wide draw driven along to take up a position outside leader, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, no extra passing 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下居領放馬外側。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。跑過一百米處時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made all, pressed by runner-up from 400m out, headed 150m out, fought back to regain the lead close home, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。自四百米處起受亞軍馬匹追迫。一百五十米處被超越。接近終點時反先對手，再次取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但終點線上不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier settling 3-wide without cover in 5th some 3L off the pace, gradually faded under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Away in line, went forward chasing leaders, raced keenly early and middle stages, couldn't keep up with the pace passing 250M, faded towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前追趕領先馬匹，早段及中段搶口。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上步速。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W2W) Ridden from stalls to track leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。直路初率先加速，取得領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not far off the leaders early stages, checked 750M losing ground, had 3-4Ls to make up 400M, lacked a finishing kick and was safely held in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百五十米處勒避，失地。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺乏力，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in worse than midfield and waited with, obtained a run just over 200M out and quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，留力候上。就在過了二百米處後取得空位上前。以佳勢加速，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 1 raced behind midfield towards the outside of the group, ran on one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘後居中間之後位置，靠近馬群外側競跑。最後四百米保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處發生碰撞。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 100m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。一百米處一度受阻礙，掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) In 4th spot always close enough to leaders, moved up to challenge for the lead passing 300M, no match for winner's pace final 200M. Finished clear 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 居第四位，沿途緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時上前爭奪領先。最後二百米加速力不及頭馬。跑獲亞軍，拋離餘駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Jumped on terms, up with pace early stages before easing back to a trailing spot behind leaders, fought hard in the straight but couldn't muster the pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘。早段跟上步速，其後收慢留居領先馬匹之後，有遮擋。直路上力拼，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden early gradually settling some 2L back in 4th over 600M out, commenced move home bend and ran on under pressure for slender advantage inside the 150M, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 早段受催策，六百米處逐漸居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。直路彎開始發力，受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, disputed led final bend, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。直路彎爭奪領先。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) From draw 10 sent forward vying for early lead, emerged as clear leader going into home turn, kept going well in the straight, headed nearing 150M before fading to finish 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘，早段受催策上前爭奪領先。進入直路彎時領放。直路上保持佳勢，接近一百五十米處時被超越，其後力竭，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to be up with the pace settling one-out-one-back 650M out, fought on steadily from a similar position into straight but never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策以跟上步速。六百五十米處居第二疊第二位。入直路時居相若位置，持續力拼，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kicked clear from the 500M, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。自五百米處起加速帶離對手，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 800M, took the lead 600M, shared lead with rival turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過八百米處後追近。六百米處取得領先。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路上保持甚佳走勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W1W) Made running, headed 50m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W1W) 領放。五十米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact with the left side of its starting gate on jumping and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂左側及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped on terms from gate 3 and settled 4th smoking the pipe, happy to follow the winner's back until around 300m when rider pressed the button and stayed on well from there (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第三檔與對手同步出閘，居第四位，走勢輕鬆。跟隨頭馬，直至約三百米處受催策，自該處起以佳勢上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until 75M, made good progress thereafter to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至七十五米處。其後追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Began awkwardly, settled down 2-wide behind midfield in a steadily run race, closed off moderately final 300M to take 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊，賽事步速平穩。最後三百米衝刺普通，跑獲第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Taken well back from a poor draw for rails run, pulled slightly closer to 10th inside the 1000M, baulked behind runners early in home straight, ran on well inside final 200M to snatch 2nd close to home without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自外檔出閘後遙居後列，走內欄。一千米處略為追近至第十位。直路早段在馬匹之後受困。最後二百米走勢良佳，接近終點時跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Ridden along the rail to be up with the pace before settling one back in 3rd on rail inside the 700M, soon came to tackle leaders on straightening holding every chance despite tight run 150M out and only to be denied narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 沿欄受催策，跟隨領放馬。七百米處居第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。入直路時瞬即追趕領先馬匹，儘管一百五十米處緊迫競跑，但已獲機會盡展所長。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, nothing extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, showed good speed to lead, ridden 300m out, headed 100m out and faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，展現甚快前速領放。三百米處受催策。一百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover behind the pacesetters, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, lacked the extra from 200M and was only battling from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初力拼以保持爭勝機會。自二百米處起再無餘力，僅能勉力而為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Midfield early before gaining to share 4th about 1000M out, became 4th outright some 2L back when tempo slackened about 800M out, kept on steadily without quickening in straight and swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居中間位置，約一千米處上前居並列第四位。約八百米處步速減慢時仍居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。直路上保持穩勢，未能加速。最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well to be sharing the lead early stages, sat in 3rd from 900M, quickened up well on straightening, led mid-straight then kept on determinedly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段並排領先。自九百米處起居第三位。入直路時以佳勢加速上前。直路中段取得領先，保持強勁走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting in for cover in 3L 4th onto first bend, further off the lead in increased tempo in back straight, renewed effort over 400M out and hit the front 200M out, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。開始轉首個彎位時向內移入以取得遮擋，居第四位，落後三個馬位。對面直路上步速加快時落後領放馬更遠。四百米處重新發力。二百米處取得領先，終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Up with early pace before easing back to race ahead of midfield, had some difficulty obtaining clear running 300M-200M then attacked the line well to be nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段跟上前速，其後收慢留居中間之前位置。三百米處至二百米處之間頗為難以望空，其後以佳勢衝刺。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Blundered on jumping, chased leaders in 3rd, driven along 400M and moved up to 2nd nearing 200M, couldn't get closer to the winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 躍出時失蹄。追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。四百米處受催策，接近二百米處時上前進佔第二位。末段未能追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Went forward and settled just off the pace early stages before drifting back to a position ahead of midfield halfway, fought on one paced to the line final 300M and not making ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段上前，居領放馬稍後位置。半程時墮居中間之前位置。最後三百米力拼，保持同速，未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Positively ridden, settled just outside the lead, fought hard to stay in contention from 400M, still with leaders 100M before run came to an end and faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 受積極催策，居領放馬外側。自四百米處起在力拼下保持爭逐機會。一百米處仍居領先馬匹之中，其後無以為繼及力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Away in line, restrained to a rearward spot 6Ls off the pace, had task ahead top of the straight but was just fair through the line. Never reached contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，在約束下居後列，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。從未有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide in mid-field without cover, driven along 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W) Dropped back to race in second half of the field, pushed along 550M and brought wide for home, closed off nicely to go 3rd last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 墮居後半馬群中。五百五十米處受推策。入直路時移出外疊。末段衝刺良佳，最後一步跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段以勁勢上前，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped on terms, reserved behind midfield along the fence, 4Ls to make up 400M, did best work late to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，留居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處落後四個馬位。末段表現最佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Bumped on jumping, held up near the rear 4-5Ls, switched away from fence turning home before closing off well to take 3rd near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 躍出時發生碰撞，留居後列，落後四至五個馬位。轉直路彎時移離內欄。衝刺良佳，接近終點時進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Tracked leader, bumped 1000m out, challenged winner 400m out, ran on well to lead briefly 150m out, headed close home, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。一千米處與對手互相碰撞。四百米處挑戰頭馬。保持佳勢，一百五十米處一度取得領先。接近終點時被超越，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Not the quickest out, settled midfield 3 wide, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘並非最快，居中間位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。難以穩定走勢，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速，末段保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Heavily bumped out of stalls, ridden along to chase leader, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，受催策以追趕領放馬。三百米處迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 500M, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起走第三疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, very wide into straight, inconvenienced near 350M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位，走大外疊。接近三百五十米處時受妨礙。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped only fairly, reserved towards the rear on inside, 7Ls to make up 400M, made limited progress towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走內疊。四百米處落後七個馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride at the rear, 7Ls to make up 400M, made some progress without posing serious threat to the leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處落後七個馬位。末段略為追前，但未能真正威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W3W) In rear after slowly away, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on strongly final 100m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W3W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後一百米衝刺強勁，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response in straight, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時與一駒互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Restrained to race in midfield along the fence, was held up over the home turn when pace quickened, closed off fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎步速加快時受困。末段在催策下衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, ridden top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Held up last from widest draw, rail position throughout, chased along on bend, lacked pace to challenge, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。沿途走內欄。直路彎追趕對手。速度不足以展開挑戰。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders, commenced move out wide 600m out, sustained headway to challenge 300m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處開始發力，走外疊。持續上前，三百米處展開挑戰。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, moved closer on turn, 3 wide turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第三疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well then eased back to midfield on settling, steadied 500M losing ground, responded well when asked and made steady progress towards the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後收慢留居中間位置。五百米處收慢，失地。對催策反應良佳，末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Shifted in at start, settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑。居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Chased leaders in a 3-wide position without cover, challenged hard for the lead from 300M but couldn't quite get past leader, lost 2nd closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。自三百米處起力拼，爭奪領先，但未能超越領放馬。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Began awkwardly settling in forward of midfield 3-wide in 6th within 3L of pace, commenced move inside the 400M, quickened well inside final 150M just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前的第六位，落後領放馬不足三個馬位，走第三疊。四百米處開始上前。最後一百五十米加速良佳，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Showed good early speed to lead, kept on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 早段展現甚快前速，取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) From a wide draw shifted across behind runners to the rail, raced ungenerously early stages, badly held up rounding the home bend, flashed home once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後在馬群之後切入內欄。早段走勢欠順。轉直路彎時嚴重受困。末段望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Ridden in first few early settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd, gained 2nd 600M out 2-wide and hit the front over 200M out, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 早段受催策，居前列第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位。六百米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。二百米處取得領先。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, three wide into home straight, stayed on for pressure, couldn't quite reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走第三疊。在催策下保持走勢，但未能真正追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, sat midfield, held up making the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。轉直路彎時受困。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Mid-field, brief effort 400m out, soon flattened out, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 居中間位置。四百米處一度發力，瞬即洩氣。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 550M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。趨近五百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Commenced well, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 500M, no clear run early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。直路早段未能望空。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, joined leader 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。六百米處追上領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed forward to be racing in 2nd, fought on one paced in the straight before weakening out of contention final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 受催策上前，居第二位。直路上保持同速。最後一百米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Prominent, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, stayed on well and in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Pressed forward from an awkward draw, unable to slot in 3 wide facing the breeze the whole trip, under pressure inside 400m, gave ground quickly and tired out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。未能切入內疊，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。其後迅速墮退，力竭。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched to make run 600m out, stayed on under pressure, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處轉換跑線推進。在催策下保持走勢。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W3W) Dropped back to race at the back of the field 10Ls off leader on settling, made limited progress on straightening and was never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W3W) 留居後列，落後領放馬十個馬位。入直路時略為追前，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden 600m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled just worse than midfield in 6th or 7th, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily to snatch 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間稍後第六或第七位。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。末段穩步上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W4W) Sat midfield, minor progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W4W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W5W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W4W5W) Held up, well held from top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W4W5W) 留後。自直路初起落後甚遠，末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well from the widest barrier before taking back to share 7th 3-wide after the first 300M, drifted some 6L back to 9th 1200M out, fought on steadily under pressure inside final 300M to claim 4th 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，過了首三百米後留後，並居第七位，走第三疊。千二米處墮居第九位，落後約六個馬位。最後三百米在催策下持續力拼。五十米處進佔第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, blocked off when trying to switch 500m out, didn't get best of runs in home straight when trying to improve.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在嘗試轉換跑線之際受困。直路上嘗試推進上前，但取位不太暢順。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join the leader on first bend, chased within 2L of pace in back straight, similar turning for home when unable to quicken to challenge and swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在首個彎位追上領放馬。對面直路上落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置，未能加速以展開挑戰。最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W6W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, took the lead 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W7W) Settled in rear of mid-field, twice hampered 450m out to 350m out when trying to improve out wide, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W7W) 居中間之後位置。四百五十米處至三百五十米處之間嘗試在外疊推進時兩度受阻礙。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Bumped and lost balance 1500m out, dropped out from wide draw and quickly improved to rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 450m out, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，迅速上前進佔中間位置，走內欄。千五米處與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡。四百五十米處移離內欄。末段以佳勢上前，終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W1W1W) Settled in second half of the field early stages, raced keenly and made rapid forward move from 900M to take lead, held on gamely when challenged by rivals on both sides in the straight. Gutsy win.
(Jockey dropped whip near 150M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W1W1W) 早段居後半馬群中，搶口。自九百米處起迅速上前，取得領先。直路上受兩側對手挑戰，以勁勢力拒來犯，憑鬥志勝出。
（於接近一百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於接近一百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Bumped on jumping, took the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 躍出時發生碰撞，取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2 lengths turning in, kicked clear early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
