runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先兩個馬位。直路早段帶離餘駒，保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, chased along on bend, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路彎追趕對手。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place and pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m to move into third 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時仍居包尾位置，走最外疊，受推策。最後二百米以佳勢追前。五十米處進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, rail position in rear, driven along 550m out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，居後列，走內欄。五百五十米處受催策，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden after moderate start and checked on heels twice when travelling keenly in early stages, shared 6th 2-wide over 4L back rounding home bend, weakened under pressure approaching home turn.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步普通，其後受催策，早段搶口之際兩度勒避他駒後蹄。轉直路彎時並居第六位，落後逾四個馬位，走第二疊。趨近直路彎時受催策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處受推策。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, slightly improved along the rail on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為推進。直路初對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began fairly, settled in rear of midfield on rail in 4L 6th or 5th, did not find much room behind runners on rail early in straight, kept on to the line in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後第五或第六位，落後四個馬位，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之後空位不足，走內欄。保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, failed to respond when asked, weakened (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置。對催策毫無反應。末段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail, saved ground turning in for home, snuck up to within 2L of leaders 200M out but unable to sustain effort close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。上前，二百米處落後領先馬匹兩個馬位以內，但接近終點時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, headway up rail early in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列，直路早段沿欄追前，末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，但未能進一步威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢良佳。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W5W) From wide draw eased back to race in a rearward position, driven wide into the home straight, ran on steadily but was always held by first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 自外檔出閘，收慢留後，居後列。入直路時在催策下走外疊。走勢平穩，但一直落後頭四名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W5W) Was average to begin and angled across to the rear, given a patient ride 10Ls off the good speed, widest into the straight with stacks of ground to make up, made strong late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W5W) 出閘普通，切入內疊，居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬十個馬位，未受催策。入直路時走最外疊，落後頗遠。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W6W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能跟上步速，最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move 500M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 stayed close enough to early pace before settling back in midfield along the inside, held up for clear running making the home turn, crowded for room near 200M and not able to be ridden out to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，早段居接近領放馬的位置，其後留居中間位置，走內疊。轉直路彎時受困而未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，未能被全力催策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkward but soon in first few settling over 2L back in 4th 2-wide, came under pressure from 500M out swinging wide into straight, ran on steadily under pressure to hold every only to be outsprinted late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，但瞬即進佔前列第四位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，入直路時移出外疊。在催策下保持穩勢，已獲機會盡展所長，末段僅被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, held up making the Home Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時受困。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W3W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, made some progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W3W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路上略為追前，取得第四名，但未能對前列馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W5W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 700m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處開始上前，走外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Raced on rail in 2nd position early. Weakened at 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 早段走貼欄第二位。一百五十米力弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Box seat, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well but always held, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但一直落後，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in mid-pack but stayed close enough to leaders, picked up well when urged along near 400M, led early straight before keeping on well to the line. Just couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，但保持落後領先馬匹不遠。接近四百米處時在催策下以佳勢加速。直路初領先，其後保持佳勢至終點。僅於末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Close up early restraining one-out-one-back to 4th rounding first bend, drifted back to 6th on restraint about 750M out, kept on steadily under pressure in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。轉首個彎位時受約束，居第二疊第二位，即馬群中的第四位。約七百五十米處在約束下墮居第六位。直路上在催策下保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped after the start, obtained running in midfield, driven along 500M but not going the pace to challenge, weakened 200M. (Jockey - would be better suited by stepping up in distance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受催策，但未能加速以展開挑戰。二百米處轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎下仗若可增程角逐將更適合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Settled just off midfield on the rail, made some ground along the rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。末段沿欄略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling in midfield mainly in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning for home, ran on well under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，大多居中間第七位，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 350M, made good progress in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自三百五十米處起走第二疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Given a waiting ride in a position towards the rear, had 7Ls to make up on leader leaving the bend, ran on well under pressure and swept past long time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。跑離直路彎時仍落後領放馬七個馬位。在催策下以佳勢上前，接近終點時超越大部分途程帶頭的領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, keen early stages, driven 400m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Given a waiting ride in a position near the rear, lacked a finishing effort passing 400M. Never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。跑過四百米處時衝刺乏力。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, made some progress after passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百米處後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W3W4W) Held up, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, ran on well, heavily bumped 100m out and lost balance, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W3W4W) 留後。未能望空直至三百五十米處。以佳勢上前。一百米處與對手互相大力碰撞，失去平衡。未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 650M, 2 lengths back turning in, made good progress early in straight, bumped near 150M, peaked on run 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。自六百五十米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路初追前甚多。接近一百五十米處時被碰撞。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Bumped at the start, settled ahead of midfield about 3Ls off the pace, moved up to 3rd early straight, fought hard but couldn't close off as well as the leaders final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。直路早段追前至第三位。末段力拼，但最後二百米的衝刺不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Tracked leaders against rail, travelled smoothly to 400m out, shifted left early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百米處前走勢暢順。直路初向外斜跑。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leaders, quickened 400m out to lead 250m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處加速，二百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Away well, chased leader in a strongly run race, drove hard passing 300M and edged ahead last stride. Won in class record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，追趕領放馬，賽事步速甚快。跑過三百米處時受力策。最後一步取得領先。以破班次紀錄時間勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W5W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, ran on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。以強勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared approaching 100M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初空位不足。趨近一百米處時望空。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, short of room 400m out to 200m out, switched for clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。二百米處轉換跑線以望空，速度不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Away well, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 500M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Held up in mid-division, drifted back a bit on the home turn, had difficulty obtaining clear running from 400M -200M before staying on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 留居中間位置。直路彎略為墮後。四百米處至二百米處之間難以望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders in early and middle stages, got tired passing 300M and was easily accounted for.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，早段及中段保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時呈現疲態，其後被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, 2 wide from 600M, wider turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百米處。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W4W) Waited with in rear, commenced move out wide without cover 900m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處開始上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Waited with in rear, some headway out wide middle stages, sustained headway in home straight but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。中段略為追前，走外疊。直路上持續上前，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Settled just behind midfield, moved closer over the home turn to be 3Ls off leader 400M, fought hard in the straight couldn't find the extra gear to challenge first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 居中間稍後位置。直路彎追近。四百米處落後領放馬三個馬位。直路上力拼，但未能加速以挑戰頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Led entering first turn setting slow pace, overtaken 750M, went for the lead again turning in, drew level with eventual winner mid-straight before going down by narrow margin in a nail biting finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 進入首個彎位時以慢步速領放。七百五十米處被超越。入直路時再度上前爭奪領先。直路中段追上頭馬，末段在力拼下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Sat handy, traveled smoothly, made good ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。在鞭策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and raced outside of leader, in share of lead from 400m out, every chance until no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，居領放馬外側。自四百米處起並排領先。一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) In touch with leaders early, drifted back into mid-field back straight, when also checked briefly, stayed on under pressure final 300m, moved into third 75m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹。對面直路上墮居中間位置，一度勒避。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。七十五米處進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced 4 wide no cover midfield, under pressure from the 600M, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起受催策。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Recovered steadily on rail to 3L 6th about 1200M out after moderate start, drifted 5L back in midfield rounding home bend, one-paced under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後逐漸恢復走勢，約千二米處居第六位，落後三個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時墮後五個馬位，居中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace until approaching 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持同速直至趨近一百五十米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon taken well behind, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即遙居於後。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。再無表現。
